body: ## What's Changed * [Feature] Track count flag (Fix #439) by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/440 * Add full-screen and iTunes-style screensaver visualizers for TempoTec V1 by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/441 * Make the screensaver swipe-up arrow optional by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/443 * Tape Deck: trim/slice, 16 Levels, and choke groups by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/444 * Add Live USB remote and PEQ editor to the V1 web workbench by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/445 * Add SD card health and read-speed benchmark by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/446 * USB audio out: announce the card, and support fixed 48 kHz/16-bit DACs by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/447 * Add an opt-in podcast catcher with per-episode bookmarks by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/448 * Add lightweight MPEG-1 software video player for TempoTec V1 by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/449 * README: document the video player, Live USB, podcast catcher and screensaver modes by @mr-f0xx in https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/pull/450 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mr-f0xx/sonix-player-tempotec-v1/compare/1.7.5...1.7.6
